title: superviseRun's context and progress steps can still throw past finalize
body: 4lv fixed the boot step, but superviseRun has two more steps whose retry exhaustion escapes superviseRun before finalize: the `context` step (CONTEXT_RETRIES, limit 3) and the `progress` step (OBSERVE_RETRIES, limit 3). A context that exhausts (e.g. a persistent GitHub outage during acquireContext) or a progress read that exhausts both throw out of run(), leaving the same unfinalized shape 4lv just fixed for boots — live tokens, unsettled row, unswept containers. Same shape, same fix pattern (catch at the step, end in finalize with a reason naming the failed step); worth its own tick with its own vitest.
